2608.00765.title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
2608.00765.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become essential for knowledge-intensive question answering, yet scaling RAG pipelines remains challenging due to the prohibitive computational cost of processing lengthy retrieved contexts. Existing compression approaches face a fundamental trade-off: hard compression methods operate online in a query-aware fashion but achieve only modest compression rates and typically require fine-tuning the generative model, while soft compression methods attain higher ratios but rely on costly offline encoding that is entirely agnostic to the input query. To bridge this gap, we introduce RAGOCR, a novel framework that compresses retrieved documents into compact visual representations conditioned on the input query. To further balance compression rate and information fidelity, we introduce a query-aware dynamic resolution mechanism that adaptively allocates visual granularity based on each document's estimated relevance and complexity: highly relevant passages are rendered at higher resolution to preserve fine-grained details, while peripheral documents are aggressively compressed at lower resolution. Experiments on five QA benchmarks using the MedOmniKB retrieval corpus demonstrate that RAGOCR surpasses naive RAG by over 15\% in accuracy while requiring only one-eighth the number of input tokens, and consistently outperforms both hard and soft compression baselines across varying retrieval depths.
2608.00765.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）已成為知識密集型問答的關鍵，但由於處理冗長檢索上下文的計算成本高昂，擴展 RAG 管道仍然具有挑戰性。現有的壓縮方法面臨根本的權衡：硬壓縮方法以查詢感知的方式在線運行，但僅能達到適度的壓縮率，並且通常需要對生成模型進行微調，而軟壓縮方法則能實現更高的壓縮比，但依賴於完全與輸入查詢無關的昂貴離線編碼。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了 RAGOCR，一種新穎的框架，將檢索到的文檔壓縮為基於輸入查詢的緊湊視覺表示。為了進一步平衡壓縮率和信息保真度，我們引入了一種查詢感知的動態分辨率機制，根據每個文檔的預估相關性和複雜性自適應分配視覺粒度：高度相關的段落以更高的分辨率呈現，以保留細緻的細節，而邊緣文檔則以較低的分辨率進行強烈壓縮。在使用 MedOmniKB 檢索語料庫的五個 QA 基準上的實驗表明，RAGOCR 在準確性上超過了天真的 RAG 超過 15\%，同時僅需八分之一的輸入標記數，並在不同檢索深度上始終優於硬壓縮和軟壓縮基準。
